title: Executive Leadership
description: Schema for the elected executive of the city: the City Mayor and the City Vice Mayor. Fields that have not been verified against a civic source are null, never invented or filled with placeholder text. A person is named in a seat only when two independent source families name them there; the seat itself is published regardless, so a withheld name reads as a fact about this portal rather than an empty office.

slug.description: Stable identifier for the seat, not the person, so it survives a change of office-holder. Lowercase, hyphen-separated.

role.description: The seat as the city publishes it, e.g. "City Mayor".

name_status.description: Why the name is or is not published. `published` requires name to be present. `conflicting_sources`: official sources name different people and nothing establishes which is current. `uncorroborated`: fewer than two independent source families name anyone. Both withheld states require name to be null.

name.description: The office-holder's name as published, without honorifics. Null unless established by two independent source families.

office.description: The office the official heads, as the city names it. Null until sourced.

term.description: Term of office, e.g. "2025–2028". Null unless an election source establishes the election the term follows from.

address.description: Null until an authoritative address is sourced for the official.

phone.description: Null until a source states a number for the official.

email.description: Null until a source states an address for the official.

website.description: Null until an authoritative page is sourced.

personId.description: Optional link to an OpenLGU person record.

sources.description: Civic-source ids from src/data/sources/civic-sources.json naming this person in this seat. At least two, from at least two independent source families; the provenance test enforces the independence.
